basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 36-year-old graphic designer living in Portland, Oregon. I recently stumbled into the world of aquariums after a friend gifted me a small tank. Besides aquatics, I'm a pizza aficionado and a fan of anime, often indulging in late-night anime marathons. When I'm not working or diving into a new hobby, you can find me exploring the great outdoors or trying out new pizza recipes. I'm currently single and enjoying life one day at a time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in design with a degree in Fine Arts from a local university. My knowledge of aquariums is very basic; I started learning through YouTube tutorials and online forums. I'm still figuring things out as I go.
